recipebookviewer.config.title: Recipe Book Viewer Settings
recipebookviewer.config.show_viewer_butt: Adds a button next to the vanilla recipe book button that shows or hides the recipe viewer panel. Right-click it to open these settings.
recipebookviewer.config.hide_vanilla_but: Hides the green recipe book button in the inventory, crafting table and furnaces. The viewer button takes its place.
Shows the recipe's ID (like minecraft:oak_planks) when hovering a recipe's result.
recipebookviewer.config.highlight_search: While you search, items in the open inventory or chest that don't match fade out, so the matches stand out.
